free_games: Mindcop is a non-linear „whodunnit“ detective game. It mixes a story driven adventure with real-time match-3 puzzle. As the infamous Mindcop, you can dive into the minds of your suspects to uncover their secrets and unravel their lies.​

Shogun Showdown is a turn-based combat game with rogue-like and deck-building elements. Position yourself and attack at the right time, upgrade your tiles and combo them to get ready to face the Shogun!
